heading: Today
text: Mostly sunny and much cooler.  Highs in the 40s north, 50 to 55 south.  Winds north 5 to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some high clouds arriving late from the west.  Cold.  Lows in the 20s, falling to the teens in the cold spots.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Sun filtered through periods of clouds.  Not as cold.  Highs warming to the upper 40s and low 50s north, the mid to upper 50s south.  Winds light, mainly south less than 10 mph.
